summary: Nineteen stage-deciding documents that could not be opened directly were read through an external retrieval and alternate public copies were sought. Researchers then opened every copy they could reach (12 of the 19 documents opened in full or as a matching copy on a third-party host; 7 remain unreachable and are recorded only as external retrievals, which keeps those records at or below 79 confidence) and two independent reviewers re-fetched the deciding copies and rewrote the 16 affected records. No stage changed. Progress moved on one record (c04-09, 40 to 45, on an opened 2026-09-16 memorandum approving a Joint Pool reduction plan). Confidence rose on seven records (c04-08 66 to 74, c04-09 62 to 68, c04-31 70 to 72, c05-09 58 to 62, c05-16 72 to 76, c05-35 60 to 62, c06-25 65 to 66) and held on nine. Corrections: c05-24 no longer states that the State Department said it was resuming diversity visa issuance (the opened page does not say so); c04-15 drops a 21-day limit and a closest-facility limit that the opened Air Force memorandum does not contain; c04-02 re-dates the May 2026 memorandum to 2026-05-07. Advocacy, aggregator and anonymous-storage hosts offered by the retrieval were not used as sources.
title: Retrieval pass over 19 blocked documents
